page.title: Send Files
page.subtitle: Upload files and folders securely to the studio.

status.invalidBody: This page can only be used with a dedicated upload link. Please open the exact link you received from the studio, or contact us to get one.
status.revokedBody: This link has been revoked or has expired. Please contact the studio to receive a new upload link.
status.structuringBody: Upload finished. Reorganizing files into subfolders on Google Drive — please keep this tab open.
status.successBody: All files have been successfully uploaded to the server.

form.projectHint: Enter a project name to start the upload.
form.identityIncomplete: This upload link is missing a registered email — enter your details below, or ask the studio to update the token.

resume.title: Previous session was interrupted
resume.body: Select the exact same files again to resume your upload. Already completed files will be automatically skipped.

dropzone.main: Drag and drop files or an entire project folder here
dropzone.hint: Nested subfolders are included automatically — select or drop the top-level folder.

delta.onDriveOne: {count} file already on Drive (will be skipped).
delta.onDriveMany: {count} files already on Drive (will be skipped).
delta.allDone: Everything is already uploaded — nothing left to send.

share.intro: Download materials from the studio or add your own files. Download progress appears below.
share.dropHint: Drop files here or choose from disk. They go to the studio as later additions.
share.allHint: Full project — originals, studio files and later additions.
share.studioHint: New or updated by the studio — download these.
share.studioHintWithDate: New or updated by the studio (last send: {when}).
share.clientHint: Extra files you sent after the first upload, grouped by upload.
share.noFilesDetail: Nothing to download in this category.
share.zipTooBig: This set is too large for ZIP in the browser. Use Chrome/Edge (folder picker) or download a smaller category.
share.uploadDoneDetail: The studio will see the files in Console (FromClient).
share.savedToFolder: Saved {total} files to the selected folder.
share.mailPublishBody: Download only what the studio added or changed in the project portal (no login):
share.mailTopupBody: Thank you. Here is the summary of the files you just added through the project portal:
share.mailTopupFooter: This is an automated message. Please do not reply to this email.
